research_objects.summary: 16 synthetic cases: 7 expected-valid, 9 hostile, 0 mismatches; standing CI passed.
Live D1 research tables and seven established CTC domains verified readable.
Live D1 write attempt denied by Cloudflare permission error 7500; no persistence claimed.
Negative evidence has provenance and an object; it is not a personality trait or global instruction.

ctc_tags.rationale: Refusing one proposed action does not erase ownership of the larger inquiry.
A scoped refusal can refine or redirect the problem without closing it.

ctc_tags.domain: Technology as Tool to Think With
ctc_tags.rationale: The refusal boundary is an inspectable representation that can be revised.
The cycle generates system-evaluation evidence only and explicitly does not claim learner learning.
Reopening, revision, and change of mind remain possible without rewriting the original refusal.
Who may generalize a refusal and who controls future resurfacing are authority and power questions.
A correction to Turtle can preserve collaboration rather than being generalized into disengagement.

ontology_tags.rationale: Learner correction remains bounded and revisable rather than becoming an identity claim.
The learner retains authority over what the refusal means and whether collaboration continues.
One rejection must not predetermine future non-engagement.
A local refusal can redirect inquiry without terminating it.
Human correction changes the machine trajectory without being absorbed as a generalized preference.
Adjacent alternatives remain available after one proposal is refused.
The exact refused object and source boundary remain retrievable without copied raw dialogue.

reconciliation_findings.detail: migration-0007 research tables, CTC domains, ontology concepts

reconciliation_findings.note: 34 sources / 92 special notes recorded previously; not re-counted in this cycle.

wait_a_minute.overlap: Interaction Capture distinguishes rejection/correction/revision/ambiguity while Initiative Authority treats quieting as scoped authority. Refusal Scope connects those layers by making negative evidence object-specific.
wait_a_minute.why_it_matters: Persistent systems can either forget a real refusal and pester, or overremember a local refusal and suppress future possibility.
wait_a_minute.uncertainty: Structural scope does not prove perceived respect; natural-language deixis may leave the target unresolved.

uncaptured_observations: Natural-language deixis can leave the refused object unresolved even when the persistence contract is exact.
A structurally correct future silence may not be experienced by a learner as respectful.
Refusal-target resolution may require WorldSpec/world-state pointers without widening collection.
No new CTC domain is justified.
